description: This file contains shell script tests for verifying the behavior of 'git update-index --refresh' in relation to racy timestamps. It defines setup and test functions, and runs a series of test cases to check how the update-index command handles timestamp races, especially with respect to ctime and mtime, using the 'test-lib.sh' library.

methods.name: reset_files
methods.description: Resets the file contents and sets their modification times to a known state.

methods.name: update_assert_changed
methods.description: Runs 'git update-index --refresh' and asserts that the index's timestamp is updated.
